senses.gloss: Den,Ⓒs.ⒹbilaM, vivaraM, guhA, gahvaraM, kaMdaraH, kuharaM.

Denizen,Ⓒs.Ⓓni-vAsin m., okas in comp.; ‘d(enizen)s of heaven’ divOkasaH, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 pOraH, nAgaraH, nagarajanaH, svataMtrajanaH.

Denominate,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓvad-BaR-gad Ahve 1 P, vyapadiS 6 P, aBiDA 3 U, vac 2 P, KyA 2 P; See Calll also.
Ⓝ[Denominat]ion,Ⓒs.ⒹnAman n., aBiDAnaM, saMjYA, AKyA.
Ⓝ[Denominat]ive,Ⓒa.ⒹaBiDA-yin, AKyAyaka; (in grammar) nAma-DAtuH.
Ⓝ[Denominat]or,Ⓒs.ⒹnAmakft-nAmadAtf m.
Ⓑ
 2 haraH, hAraH, CedaH; ‘of the same d(enominator)’ samacCeda; ‘reduced to the same d(enominator)’ savarRita.

Denote,Ⓒv. t.ⒹnirdiS 6 P, sUc 10, upalakz 10, vac 2 P, aBiDA 3 U, dyut c., gam c. (gamayati); oft. ex. by arTa in comp.; See Mean; ‘the word kzetra here d(enote)s body’ atra kzetraSabdaH SarIrArTe-rTaH.
Ⓝ[Denot]ation,Ⓒs.ⒹnirdeSaH; sUcanaM; aBiDA-DAnaM, upalakzaRaM-RA.
Ⓝ[Denot]ing, [Denot]ative,Ⓒa.ⒹsUcaka, darSaka, vAcaka, aBiDAyaka, gamaka.

Denounce,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓ(amaMgalaM or anizwaM) pra-kAS c. KyA c., (KyApayati), A-ni-vid c., kaT 10.
Ⓑ
 2 prakASaM tarj 10 A, Barts 10 A, aBiSap 1 U, aBiSaMs 1 P, niMd 1 P, garh 1, 10 A, AkruS 1 P.
Ⓝ[Denounc]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓani-zwAvedakaH.
Ⓑ
 2 aDikzepakaH, niMdakaH.
Ⓝ[Denounce]ment, Denunciation,Ⓒs.ⒹanizwaKyApanaM-prakASanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 nirBartsanA-naM, AkroSaH, aBiSaMsanaM, niMdA, garhA.

Dense,Ⓒa.ⒹGana, nibiqa, sAMdra, avirala, niraM-tara, anaMtara, gAQa, gahana.
Ⓑ
 2 susaMhata, dfQa, pI-vara.
Ⓝ[Dens]ity,Ⓒs.ⒹGanatA, sAMdratA, AnaMtaryaM; pIvaratA.
Denude, Denudate,Ⓒv. t.ⒹnagnIkf 8 U, vivastrIkf vivastrayati (D.). vastraM apahf 1 P, SUnyIkf; nir in comp.; ‘a tree d(enudat)ed of leaves’ nizpatro or nizpatrIkftoH vfkzaH.

Deny,Ⓒv. t.Ⓓapalap 1 P, apavad 1 P, na svIkf-aMgIkf 8 U, niziD 1 P, pratyAKyA 2 P, ni-apa-hnu 2 A, pratyAdiS 6 P.
Ⓝ[Deni]al,Ⓒs.Ⓓa-pa-ni-hnavaH, pratyAdeSaH, nizeDaH, asvIkAraH, pratyAKyAnaM, apalApaH; ‘self d(nial)’ AtmasaMyamaH, AtmanigrahaH.
Ⓝ[Deni]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓnihnotf m., apalApin m., pratyAdeSakaH.
